messages:
nora (sec): Heads-up: we want to strip CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_NET_ADMIN, CAP_NET_RAW from our base images and remove common setuid binaries. Need to align on RBAC for signing, audit logs, and a safe rollout. short checklist?
diego (infra): Agreed. First step: inventory. I'll run pod/image scans for added caps, hostNetwork, hostPID, and suid files.
sasha (eng-runtime): Kubectl snippets: `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name} {.spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add}\n{end}' | grep -v "<none>"` and scan images with a DaemonSet running `find / -perm /4000 -type f`. Run in staging first.
emma (platform): For signing: prefer per-team KMS keys. TF module will create cryptoKeys, grant cryptoKeySign to build SA, and enable Data Access audit logs. I'll also add Workload Identity docs.
nora (sec): Good. Key rotation policy? Thinking quarterly + on-major-rebase; require automated re-sign job for prod images.
diego (infra): I'll verify audit config; Data Access logs are often off. Also will ensure signing is done with short-lived tokens.
sasha (eng-runtime): Rollout plan: 1) inventory + owner notif 2) Gatekeeper audit-mode policy for 2 weeks 3) rebuild + sign per-team images to canary namespaces 4) deny enforcement after successful canary.
emma (platform): I'll prepare TF PR and an example IAM binding, pinging nora for approval.
audit-bot: SEC-745 created: task=inventory; assignee=diego; due=2024-10-27.
nora (sec): Action items assigned. Keep communications in this thread and tag SEC-745 for updates. :thumbsup:
